d: Gautam Adani Succession Plan: Who will lead the ₹17 lakh crore Adani Group after Gautam Adani steps away? In an exclusive interview with Fortune India published on November 10, 2026, Gautam Adani discussed the group's next generation of leadership, involving his two sons Karan Adani and Jeet Adani, and his two nephews Pranav Adani and Sagar Adani.
